strategies.name: Opportunity Engine
strategies.verdict: The high-conviction DECISION engine — not another strategy, a strict judge. Regime-gated weighted voting across all 9 specialist bots → a 0-100 confidence score on 8 confirmations → risk/execution filters. It REFUSES low-quality trades: only 75+ scored, multi-confirmation, filter-passing setups are taken. Forward-paper now; earns go-live after 10 profitable closed trades.
strategies.desc: Detects the live regime, lets only regime-appropriate specialists vote (weighted), scores each opportunity 0-100, and executes only the highest-conviction setups that clear every risk filter. Fully explainable — you see exactly why each trade was or wasn't taken.

strategies.name: Moonshot Compounder
strategies.verdict: MISSION bot — starts with ₹5,000 paper and reinvests EVERY rupee of profit (true compounding) into the single highest-conviction Opportunity-Engine setup it can afford, riding winners with a trailing stop. Ruin-aware: one trade can never wipe it out (a zero ends the mission). HONEST: ₹5,000→₹5,000cr is a 10,000,000× moonshot — decades even at world-beating returns, with real drawdowns. This maximises long-run growth; it does not promise the target.
strategies.desc: Concentrates the whole (growing) account into the best setup, compounds realised profit forward, trails the stop to let winners run. The most aggressive responsible compounder — a real moonshot, not a fantasy.

strategies.name: Momentum Breakout
strategies.verdict: Validated edge in BULL regimes (97 trades, +0.85%/trade); stand aside in chop/bear.
strategies.desc: Buys 20-day Donchian breakouts in an uptrend; ATR stop, rides to the channel exit. Long-only, delivery.

strategies.name: Opening Range Breakout
strategies.verdict: Live intraday forward-paper bot (5-min): breaks the first-15-min range, squares off by close. A clean HISTORICAL backtest needs deep intraday data (Kite caps 5-min history), so its evidence is the live forward test — watch it in Monitor/Accuracy.
strategies.desc: Marks the first 15-min high/low, goes long on a break above the range high, exits below the range low or at square-off. High-volatility opening-drive momentum.

strategies.name: VWAP Reversion
strategies.verdict: Live intraday forward-paper bot (5-min): fades price stretched >1.5 ATR below the session VWAP, targets VWAP. Backtest is intraday-data-limited (Kite), so evidence is the live forward test. Best on balanced, two-sided days; disable on strong trend days.
strategies.desc: Buys when price stretches well below the session VWAP on a balanced day, exits on reversion to VWAP (or square-off). Session VWAP resets daily.

strategies.name: VWAP Momentum
strategies.verdict: Live intraday forward-paper bot (5-min): rides price holding above the session VWAP with a rising EMA9 + firm volume — the TREND side of VWAP. Intraday data limits a clean historical backtest, so the live forward test is the evidence. Best on trend days; squares off by close.
strategies.desc: Long while price holds above the session VWAP with momentum & volume; exits on a loss of VWAP. Intraday trend-following.

strategies.name: EMA 9/21 Scalp
strategies.verdict: Live intraday forward-paper bot (5-min): fast EMA9>EMA21 momentum with a tight ATR stop & quick target — in-and-out bursts. Forward-tested (intraday data depth limits a daily backtest). Many small trades; needs a trending intraday tape, bleeds in chop.
strategies.desc: Long when EMA9>EMA21, price above EMA9 and volume firm; exits below EMA21 or square-off. Fast intraday momentum.

strategies.name: Bollinger Squeeze Breakout
strategies.verdict: Live intraday forward-paper bot (5-min): after a volatility squeeze (bands tighter than their recent average), goes long on a break above the upper band with volume — riding the expansion. Forward-tested. Failed breakouts in chop are the main risk; squares off by close.
strategies.desc: Buys an intraday breakout above the upper Bollinger band out of a squeeze, on volume; exits below the mid band or square-off.

strategies.name: Intraday Supertrend
strategies.verdict: Live intraday forward-paper bot (5-min): a fast Supertrend (ATR bands) that rides sustained intraday trends and flips to cash when the trend breaks. Trades actively on any directional day; whipsaws in chop are the main risk. Squares off by close.
strategies.desc: Goes long while a fast 5-min Supertrend points up; exits when it flips down or at square-off.

strategies.name: VWAP Pullback
strategies.verdict: Live intraday forward-paper bot (5-min): on a day trending up (rising session VWAP, price above it), buys the first pullback to the VWAP that bounces — riding strength, the opposite of fading it. Exits on a loss of VWAP or square-off.
strategies.desc: Buys the dip back to a rising session VWAP in an intraday uptrend; exits below VWAP or at square-off.

strategies.name: Opening Drive
strategies.verdict: Live intraday forward-paper bot (5-min): in the first 30 minutes, if price holds above the day's open and the session VWAP on above-average volume, rides the opening drive — the most liquid, most trending part of the day. Exits on a loss of VWAP or square-off.
strategies.desc: Rides morning momentum: long in the first 30 min when price holds above the open + VWAP on volume; exits below VWAP or at square-off.

strategies.name: Relative-Volume Breakout
strategies.verdict: Live intraday forward-paper bot (5-min): breaks the high of the last several bars ONLY when that bar trades ≥2× its average volume and price is above the session VWAP — the relative-volume gate rejects thin fakeouts. Squares off by close.
strategies.desc: Long on a 5-min breakout confirmed by a ≥2× relative-volume spike, above VWAP; exits below VWAP or at square-off.

strategies.name: Intraday RSI(2)
strategies.verdict: Live intraday forward-paper bot (5-min): buys a fast RSI(2) oversold dip only while price is above its intraday EMA20 (a pullback, not a collapse) and ticking back up. Frequent small-edge trades for range days. Exits when RSI recovers, price loses EMA20, or square-off.
strategies.desc: Buys 5-min RSI(2) oversold bounces in an intraday uptrend; exits on RSI recovery, below EMA20, or square-off.

strategies.name: Mean Reversion (RSI+BB)
strategies.verdict: Loses overall, but has a CHOPPY-only edge (+3.76%, just 7 trades — thin). Regime-gate to Choppy; avoid in trends.
strategies.desc: Fades oversold RSI below the lower Bollinger band. Only viable when gated to rangebound markets.

strategies.name: RSI-2 Dip (Connors)
strategies.verdict: Validated HIGH-VOL edge (+1.41%, 37 trades, 84% win). Buys sharp oversold dips in uptrends — shines when volatility spikes.
strategies.desc: Larry Connors RSI(2): buys 2-period RSI oversold inside a 200-SMA uptrend; exits on a close above the 5-SMA.

strategies.name: Golden Cross (50/200)
strategies.verdict: Long-horizon trend-follower — big per-trade numbers span multiple regimes (held for months), so entry-regime attribution overstates it. Needs a horizon-aware backtest.
strategies.desc: Buys the 50-over-200 SMA golden cross, holds while the trend persists. Classic positional trend strategy.

strategies.name: Supertrend
strategies.verdict: As configured (10,3 daily) it barely closes trades — acts like buy-and-hold in strong uptrends. Needs a shorter timeframe / tuning before it's testable.
strategies.desc: ATR-band trend follower; long while the Supertrend direction is up. Very popular on Indian charts.

strategies.name: Low-Volatility Quality
strategies.verdict: Defensive low-vol basket — 5yr monthly-rebalance backtest is strong full-period (Sharpe 0.62, 56% win, +0.93%/rebalance) BUT negative OUT-OF-SAMPLE lately (−12.9%): recent calm-stock leadership faded. Candidate — forward-paper it to confirm the OOS holds before live.
strategies.desc: Ranks the universe by trailing volatility, holds the calmest names, rebalances on a monthly cadence. Your first downside-resilient sleeve — no market-trend filter (meant to hold through downturns).

strategies.name: Relative-Strength Rotation
strategies.verdict: Validated cross-sectional momentum: 5yr monthly-rebalance backtest, +0.70%/rebalance, 59% win, and a POSITIVE out-of-sample (+16.0%). Regime-gated — holds the strongest names only when the index is above its 200-DMA, else goes to cash. Distinct from single-name Momentum: fires even in narrow-leadership tapes.
strategies.desc: Ranks the universe by 6-month return, holds the top names equally, rebalances behind a market-trend filter. Spreads the trend bet across a basket; cash in downtrends.

strategies.name: EMA Crossover (20/50)
strategies.verdict: Validated trend edge: +1.49%/trade over 136 trades, strong in BULL (+1.41%, 58) and HIGH-VOL (+1.74%, 31). Faster than the 50/200 golden cross; stand aside in bear.
strategies.desc: Goes long when the 20-EMA crosses above the 50-EMA and holds the trend; exits on the cross back down. Long-only, delivery.

strategies.name: ADX Trend Filter
strategies.verdict: Has a real BULL directional edge (+0.36%, 89 trades) but loses NET across regimes (-0.15%/trade). Candidate: only viable hard-gated to Bull — the ADX filter alone isn't enough.
strategies.desc: Long only when ADX>25 confirms trend strength, +DI leads -DI, and price is above the 50-SMA; exits when the trend fades. Long-only, delivery.

strategies.name: Bollinger Reversion
strategies.verdict: High win rate (60%) but a thin per-trade edge (+0.29%); only really pays in HIGH-VOL (+1.58%). Candidate: needs the High-Vol gate + more out-of-sample trades before live capital.
strategies.desc: Buys a close below the lower Bollinger band (2σ) inside a 200-SMA uptrend; exits on reversion to the band mid. Long-only.

strategies.name: Z-Score Reversion
strategies.verdict: Validated reversion: 66% win over 306 trades, a strong HIGH-VOL edge (+2.36%, 47) plus a broad BULL base (+0.17%, 204). Fades 1.5σ dips in uptrends; avoid choppy/bear.
strategies.desc: Buys when price is >1.5 std-devs below its 10-bar mean inside an uptrend; exits on reversion to the mean. Faster than Bollinger. Long-only.

strategies.name: NR7 Volatility Breakout
strategies.verdict: Validated breakout: +0.43%/trade with a solid BULL edge (+0.90%, 86 trades). Trades expansion out of the narrowest-range bar; low win rate (31%) offset by large winners.
strategies.desc: After the narrowest range in 7 bars (a coil), goes long on a break above that bar's high in an uptrend; trails under the 50-SMA. Long-only.

strategies.name: Pairs Stat-Arb
strategies.verdict: Best candidate — OOS Sharpe 0.56, market-neutral so regime-agnostic. Not yet proven live.
strategies.desc: Mean-reverts the spread between correlated stocks (e.g. TATASTEEL/JSWSTEEL) using stock futures to hold both legs. Market-neutral.

strategies.name: Index Premium Selling
strategies.verdict: LIVE forward-paper bot now: sells a ~2% OTM Nifty strangle on the weekly expiry, marks every leg to the real chain, manages to a 50%-credit target / 2× stop / expiry. No historical backtest is possible (Kite can't rebuild expired chains), so the live forward test IS the evidence — watch it in Monitor. Naked short premium: aggressive, tail-risk to manage.
strategies.desc: Sells a delta-neutral Nifty strangle (OTM call + put) to collect theta; mechanical target/stop. Prefer the defined-risk Iron Condor unless you accept open tail risk.

strategies.name: Index Futures Trend
strategies.verdict: Tested on 4yr Nifty & BankNifty daily (15bps): too few signals (n=15) and NO bull edge (−0.58%/9 bull trades). One index on daily bars can't produce a testable sample — needs intraday data. Honestly NOT validated.
strategies.desc: Rides Nifty/BankNifty futures with an EMA-trend filter and ATR position sizing; flat when the regime is choppy.

strategies.name: Index Iron Condor
strategies.verdict: LIVE forward-paper bot now — the defined-risk CARRY sleeve. Sells a ~2% OTM Nifty call+put spread with BOUGHT wings (capped max loss) on the weekly expiry, marks to the real chain, targets 50% of credit. Uncorrelated to the directional equity bots. No historical backtest (Kite can't rebuild expired chains) — the live forward test is the evidence; earns go-live after 10 profitable closed structures.
strategies.desc: Sells an OTM call spread + put spread on Nifty when range-bound; collects theta while price stays inside the wings. Defined max loss = wing width − credit.

strategies.name: Cash-Futures Basis Carry
strategies.verdict: Near-market-neutral CARRY — captures the futures basis (premium/discount) + roll yield by holding the future against its cash leg. Low correlation to everything directional. Candidate: needs the basis/roll backtest with real financing costs modelled.
strategies.desc: Holds a future vs its underlying (or rolls the calendar) to harvest the basis and roll yield. Regime-agnostic, low-vol carry.

strategies.name: Commodity Trend
strategies.verdict: BLOCKED: MCX data is readable but MCX trading is NOT enabled on your Kite profile. Activate the commodity segment (KYC) with your broker before this can be backtested for live, let alone deployed.
strategies.desc: Donchian / EMA trend-following on Gold, Silver and Crude futures — commodities show more persistent trends than equities.

strategies.name: Gold–Silver Ratio
strategies.verdict: BLOCKED: needs MCX trading enabled (not on your account today). Classic commodity stat-arb, but un-deployable until the commodity segment is activated — gated by the readiness checklist.
strategies.desc: Trades mean-reversion of the gold/silver ratio via MCX futures — long one leg, short the other when the ratio stretches from its band.
